hero_tower_dark.description: A real photograph of a single tall art-deco skyscraper at NIGHT, vertical/portrait composition, the ENTIRE building visible from base to spire, isolated against a dark/black sky.

hero_tower_light.description: Art-deco tower in DAYTIME against an overcast sky, vertical/portrait, entire building base-to-spire, centered.

preloader_background.description: A cinematic, dark, luxurious architectural photograph for a full-screen intro looking up between dark skyscrapers.

visual_enhancers.overlays: Heavy dark overlay with a gold logo appearing on top for preloader
visual_enhancers.blend_modes: hero_tower_dark should blend into a #050505 background via feathered mask edges. hero_tower_light will be blended into an ivory #F2EFE8 background using multiply blend mode.

instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow the E1 Anti-AI Designer persona guidelines. Maintain deep contrast, elegant transitions, and robust interactive elements. Avoid generic templates.
